::: {.proj-intro}

<img src="logo.png" align="right" width="30%" class="proj-featured" alt="Codificando">

Codificando is a qualitative analysis environment (CAQDAS) for coding interviews, documents and notes directly on the PDF page. It was made for research that needs a codebook, excerpts, queries and reports without sending the data off the machine.

:::

## What it is

The application is built in **Tauri 2**, with a core in Rust and an interface in React. The entire base — documents, codes, excerpts and notes — lives in local files, with no account, server or telemetry. The current version is **0.2.4**.

## How it works

The researcher creates a project, imports the documents and builds the hierarchical codebook, with colors and definitions. Coding happens on the PDF page itself: the excerpt is selected and receives one or more codes, forming the basis for queries, counts and reports.

## Main features

- **Import** of PDF, DOCX, TXT and RTF;
- **Coding directly on the page**, with excerpts marked in the document;
- **Hierarchical codebook**, with colors, definitions and count per code;
- **Queries and reports** on the frequency and distribution of codes;
- **Comments and notes** per document and per excerpt;
- **Search** in the project and in the documents;
- **Local data**, with no synchronization or sending to external services.

## Requirements and installation

There are installers for **macOS (Apple Silicon)** and **Windows (x64)**, as well as a PDF manual attached to each version. The application is free and has no developer certificate: on first launch, macOS asks you to confirm with **Open** and Windows with **More info → Run anyway**. After that, the warning does not return.
